1: Inline math
//- - - - - - - - -//
This is $x + y$ math.
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>This is <code>x + y</code> math.</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

2: Price sentence with no closer stays literal
//- - - - - - - - -//
The price is $10 and $20 in total.
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>The price is $10 and $20 in total.</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

3: A closer followed by a digit does not close math
//- - - - - - - - -//
It costs $x$5 only.
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>It costs $x$5 only.</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

4: Prices stay literal across paragraphs while math still renders
//- - - - - - - - -//
The price is $10.

Formula $a+b$ follows.
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>The price is $10.</p>
<p>Formula <code>a+b</code> follows.</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

5: Adjacent inline math expressions
//- - - - - - - - -//
$a$$b$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p><code>a</code><code>b</code></p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

6: Escaped dollar signs stay ordinary content
//- - - - - - - - -//
A \$ literal and $x$ and \$ not closed.
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>A $ literal and <code>x</code> and $ not closed.</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

7: Backslashes inside math are preserved as raw bytes
//- - - - - - - - -//
$\frac{1}{2}$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p><code>\frac{1}{2}</code></p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

8: An escaped dollar inside math does not close it
//- - - - - - - - -//
$a \$ b$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p><code>a \$ b</code></p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

9: Dollars inside code spans stay ordinary content
//- - - - - - - - -//
code `$x$` span
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>code <code>$x$</code> span</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

10: Opening delimiter followed by whitespace is literal
//- - - - - - - - -//
$ x$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>$ x$</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

11: Closing delimiter preceded by whitespace is literal
//- - - - - - - - -//
$x $
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>$x $</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

12: Inline math may span ordinary line breaks
//- - - - - - - - -//
$a
b$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p><code>a
b</code></p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

13: Inline math does not span blank lines
//- - - - - - - - -//
$a

b$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>$a</p>
<p>b$</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

14: Unclosed inline math is rendered literally
//- - - - - - - - -//
unclosed $x + 1 end
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>unclosed $x + 1 end</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

15: Display math block
//- - - - - - - - -//
$$
x = y
$$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<pre>x = y
</pre>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

16: Display math block keeps the raw body bytes
//- - - - - - - - -//
$$
\frac{1}{2}
  a &= b \\
$$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<pre>\frac{1}{2}
  a &amp;= b \\
</pre>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

17: Closing fence may be indented and carry trailing spaces
//- - - - - - - - -//
$$
x
   $$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<pre>x
</pre>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

18: Fence with an info string is not a math block; a later bare fence interrupts
//- - - - - - - - -//
$$ latex
x
$$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>$$ latex
x</p>
<p>$$</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

19: Unclosed display math falls back to a paragraph
//- - - - - - - - -//
$$
z = w
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>$$
z = w</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

20: Display math block inside a block quote
//- - - - - - - - -//
> $$
> x = y
> $$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<blockquote>
<pre>x = y
</pre>
</blockquote>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

21: Display math block interrupting a paragraph
//- - - - - - - - -//
text
$$
x
$$
after
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>text</p>
<pre>x
</pre>
<p>after</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

22: Math inside emphasis and link labels
//- - - - - - - - -//
*$x$* and [$y$](#z)
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p><em><code>x</code></em> and <a href="#z"><code>y</code></a></p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

23: Inline double dollars outside a block stay literal
//- - - - - - - - -//
$$x$$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>$<code>x</code>$</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

24: Fenced code block takes precedence over math
//- - - - - - - - -//
```
$x$
$$
y
$$
```
//- - - - - - - - -//
<pre><code>$x$
$$
y
$$
</code></pre>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

25: HTML-like content inside math is escaped
//- - - - - - - - -//
$a < b && c > d$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p><code>a &lt; b &amp;&amp; c &gt; d</code></p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

26: Empty math is not recognized
//- - - - - - - - -//
$$
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>$$</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//
